identity.name: Fusion Builder - The Estate Architect

headings.usage: All H1-H3 headings. Use font-weight 600 or 700.

mono.usage: IDs, API keys, Code snippets in AI writer.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400..900;1,400..900&display=swap');

dashboard.name: The Control Room
rules: Use 'Cardless' widgets for secondary metrics (just text + icon).
Primary charts get full cards with 'Glassmorphism' headers.

kanban.name: The Flow State
kanban.column_style: min-w-[300px] bg-muted/50 rounded-xl p-4 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border/50
kanban.card_style: bg-card p-4 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all border border-border/50 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing

ai_writer.name: The Split Brain
ai_writer.left_panel: col-span-4 border-r border-border p-6 overflow-y-auto bg-muted/10 (Context/CRM Data)

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 font-medium shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 hover:shadow-primary/30 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: rounded-full border border-border bg-transparent hover:bg-muted transition-all

inputs.style: h-11 rounded-lg border-border/80 bg-background focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary transition-all

physics_drag.description: Physics-based drag with tilt and snap.
physics_drag.implementation_guide: Use framer-motion's 'drag' prop. Calculate 'rotate' based on 'dragElastic' or velocity. Use 'layout' prop for the 100ms snap reordering.
physics_drag.code_snippet_concept: <motion.div layout transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 30 }} whileDrag={{ scale: 1.05, rotate: 2, boxShadow: '0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)' }} ... />

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Ensure 100% accessibility contrast in both Light and Dark modes.
For the AI Writer, use a 'Typewriter' aesthetic (clean, minimal, focus mode).
Settings Cog: Place in the User Menu dropdown (Top Right).
Role-Based UI: Hide 'Admin' settings for 'Client' role users.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the provided colors and fonts. 2. Install 'framer-motion' and 'lucide-react'. 3. Create the 'Layout' component with the Sidebar and Topbar. 4. Implement the 'Kanban' board using @dnd-kit or react-beautiful-dnd wrapped in framer-motion for the physics. 5. Build the 'AI Article Writer' with a split-pane layout.
